author: Arconvaas
quote: Just wrapped up my gameplay of the story and it's unfortunately not good. Jason as a MC seems bland and soulless at times, Lucia just seems like your run of the mill Latina you'll find in the south, annoying, obnoxious at times and also bland as a character. The entire storyline had its ups and downs but mostly downs in my opinion. Waited 13 years since GTA 5 and it's legendary main cast, to get this? Feels like a spit in the face for those who loved Rockstar. The gameplay in itself was ok, nothing new besides some mechanics, but overall the same as previous mechanics. It wasn't as buggy for me as it was for others but some of the bugs i encountered were pretty annoying at times. Wish I could return it, but oh well. Hopefully I'll enjoy Online when it releases and raise this score from that experience.

author: Arconvaas
quote: I remember playing this back on the 64 growing up. Always had fond memories of the original, so I had to get this once I saw the remake. I was scared it wouldn't hold up to the original, but it absolutely has, and in some points in the game it exceeds the original. Absolutely beautiful graphics, plays great docked and undocked. It was like taking a trip down memory lane and reliving my childhood. I absolutely recommend this if someone is looking to get into the LoZ franchise!
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
